subject: URGENT unauthorised transaction on my account
body: Hi, I just received an SMS that RM2,450 was transferred out of my savings account 1620 4455 8891 at 2.13am. I did not make this transfer and I was asleep. Please block my account immediately and call me at 012-345 6789. My IC is 850412-10-5523.

subject: Third email with no reply
body: This is the third time I am writing about the same issue and I have still not received a single reply. I was promised a call back within 3 working days. It has been three weeks. If I do not hear from you I will escalate to Bank Negara.

subject: Request for 6 months bank statement
body: Hello, I need my savings account statements for the last six months for a visa application. Account number 1122 3344 5566. Can you email them to me or tell me how to download them?

subject: ATM swallowed my card
body: The ATM at Mid Valley swallowed my debit card just now and I am travelling outstation tomorrow morning. I need access to cash. How can I get my card back or get a new one today?

subject: Mohon penjadualan semula pembiayaan
